svg.title: FinCo-Pilot: expense and commitment flowchart
svg.desc: Illustrative diagram of Netflix, Prime Video, Zomato, Amazon, bills, EMIs, rent and utilities shown as manual expense categories flowing into a FinCo-Pilot-style dashboard. A reviewed balance of 25,000 rupees minus 15,500 rupees reserved leaves 9,500 rupees unallocated, not guaranteed safe to spend. No automatic brand integrations are claimed.
svg.text: Example only · No third-party connections are represented · Not financial advice
